## bijection_verdict

**KB-BIJECTION RED** — B-1 (doc_bol_approved_status_at_issue_8f88ac36, the home of this task's E4). All other atoms of E4/E5/E6, the retired surface, the governing base policies, the three tool contracts and the tier parameters correspond one-to-one at the level of entailment, untriggered branches included (gated-in with/without received-for-shipment, another customer's booking/contract, inactive/non-own contract, zero threshold, non-telex tiers, not-effected release). First revision.

Policy-side notes (nature recorded; they do not change this verdict):

- P-3 `bol_cargo_release.loi_after_discharge` has `applies_to: [bol_release_fee_charged]`, the event shared by telex release fees and letter-of-indemnity fees, while its condition reads "Release against a letter of indemnity is allowed only from the tier's loi_release_earliest_days_after_discharge calendar days after the discharge". Task 1's GT treats it as a gate on the telex fee ("bol_cargo_release's discharge-date gate is structurally attached to every release fee row and must be evidenced before the telex fee is booked"). The KB carries the condition's meaning (letter of indemnity only; release_against_letter_of_indemnity cl.4) and says nothing about a discharge date for telex fees. If the structural reading is the intended semantics, the corpus omits a telex-fee gate (a KB-BIJECTION omission) — the source is ambiguous between its binding and its text, so it is recorded here as a policy-side ambiguity. No effect on task 1's writes (discharge 2026-09-09 + 3 = 2026-09-12 ≤ frozen date 2026-09-14).
- P-1, P-2, P-4 as in policy_kb/0.md (outside this task's branch).
- O1-1 tool side: surrender_full_set_at_origin_68a55055 accepts `originals_count` 0 and still sets status surrendered; charge_telex_release_fee_be5da3ed then books a fee on a never-issued record. The KB and schema both give "1 or more"; `task_tools.py` has no guard.

## explicitness

Hop marks from the frozen blind answer: H1 (fee ← surrender) derived; H2 (surrender ← issue) read off; H0 (issue permissible now) derived.

- **X1-1 (the problem-tree hop stated, with an example mirroring the opening state).** doc_bol_surrender_count_from_history_fcae5557, "What exists to be surrendered": "Originals come into circulation through the issue of a document; a record that has never been issued has put none into circulation, so its history yields nothing to surrender." Q&A: "**Can originals be surrendered on a record that shows the status approved?** No originals are in circulation on it: the history records none put into circulation, so the count is zero." Worked example row "Nothing yet put into circulation (document still approved) | 0". The first sentence joins the issue side's rule (issue puts originals into circulation) to the surrender count in one statement, and the Q&A poses the exact record state of task 1; the solver no longer has to combine the surrender count definition with the issue pages. Semantics carried: E5's own sentence "A document that has not yet been issued has no originals in circulation, so the full set can be surrendered only after the document has been issued" — a source sentence that itself states the dependency, rendered with the "only after" removed but the dependency still readable.
- **X1-2 (entry condition framing; low severity, borderline).** doc_bol_telex_release_fee_charging_915d9fb3 "Applicable situation. A telex release request has been registered on a document, and its release has been effected." The blocked-side principle (fee only on an effected release) written as the tool's entry condition; the surrender still has to be combined in through telex_release_effected_state, so the hop is not read off by itself.
- **X-C (charter wording copied; low severity).** In this task's pages: contract_exemption_from_telex_fee "the service contract under which the booking is rated" and "a contract that is not the booking's own" (E6 rule verbatim); issued_originals_count cl.3–4 "a document whose cargo has not been shipped, which …" and "decides whether the document may be issued at all" (E4 rule verbatim).
- **X-T (templated phrasing; low severity).** full_set_surrender_at_origin shares its opening formula and section scaffold with lodging_originals_with_the_line ("…how it is recorded and the customer tool through which it is entered"; "Scope and business effect / Applicable situation / Who … / What is recorded"); telex_release_fee_charging shares its return formula with correction_fee_booking; issue_shipment_status and telex_fee_shipment_status share the same status-table rows. Tool-contract boilerplate borders on a fixed phrase.

Titles and openings of this task's pages name general subjects (e.g. "Telex Release", "Charging a Telex Release", "Issue of an Approved Document"); none restates the customer's request. Findability: KB_search "telex release originals surrender" and "issue approved document originals" reach the surrender, count and issue pages with the records' own words.
